sbar.situation: The bank has recovered: payments are clearing again and customers see current balances. The last two recovery checks, ending at 28 s, were both clean.
sbar.background: The clearing worker began crash-looping on malformed queue item 98, so the backlog grew and payments were not cleared. Earlier, an operator raised the gateway setting balance_cache_ttl_s from 0.5 s to 600 s.
sbar.assessment: Item 98 failed to parse with a JSONDecodeError and blocked the head of the queue (confidence 0.88); the gateway change would have shown customers stale balances for up to 10 minutes after a payment, hidden while clearing was down (confidence 0.7). The incident commander itself set item 98 aside, restarted clearing, and reverted balance_cache_ttl_s from 600 s to 0.5 s, and all three actions completed.
sbar.recommendation: The operations team has been asked (soon) to review item 98 and either repair and resubmit it or close it with its customer, so that payment is still uncleared until they act. Check with the operator who changed balance_cache_ttl_s so the 600 s value is not reapplied.
